instructions.title: Open the desktop app
instructions.detail: Open the Tealbrick desktop app on your Mac and sign in with your Portal account.

instructions.title: Approve the agent
instructions.detail: The app opens a Portal page that shows a code. Check that the code matches the app, then select Approve. This connects the app's built-in agent to this workspace.

instructions.title: Done
instructions.detail: The agent card turns to connected. Ask the agent in the app; it uses the apps you connect to it on the canvas.

instructions.title: Add a custom connector
instructions.detail: In Claude Desktop open Settings, then Connectors, then Add custom connector. Name it Tealbrick and paste this URL.

instructions.title: Connect and approve in Portal
instructions.detail: Select Connect. A browser page from your workspace opens. Select Approve in Portal, choose this agent card and confirm. You return to Claude automatically.

instructions.title: If you prefer a code
instructions.detail: On the same page, open 'I have a pairing code' and paste this one-time code (valid 10 minutes).

instructions.title: Start a new chat
instructions.detail: Start a new chat so Claude loads the Tealbrick tools and skills. The connector shows only the apps this agent may use.

instructions.title: Add the MCP server
instructions.detail: Add this server to your Codex configuration file (~/.codex/config.toml), or add a Streamable HTTP MCP server with this URL in the Codex settings.

instructions.title: Sign in
instructions.detail: Run this command (or select Sign in in the Codex settings). A browser page from your workspace opens: select Approve in Portal and choose this agent card.

instructions.title: If you prefer a code
instructions.detail: On the same page, open 'I have a pairing code' and paste this one-time code (valid 10 minutes).

instructions.title: Start a new session
instructions.detail: Start a new Codex session so it loads the Tealbrick tools.

instructions.title: Install the command line tool
instructions.detail: On the machine that runs Claude Code, install the tealbrick command line tool (0.1.20 or later) from the Tealbrick releases page.

instructions.title: Connect the agent
instructions.detail: Run this command and approve the request in the Portal page it shows (one click).

instructions.title: Add the Tealbrick tools to the agent's folder (project scope)
instructions.detail: Run this command in the folder where you start Claude Code for this agent, or add --project <folder>. It writes .mcp.json in that folder (project scope) with the full paths of this install's node and tealbrick, so Claude Code needs nothing on PATH. It shows the change and asks before it writes. Only Claude Code sessions in this folder get the tools. Run it again after you move or update the tool.

instructions.title: Start a new session
instructions.detail: Start Claude Code in that folder and approve the Tealbrick MCP server when it asks. The tools show only the apps this agent may use.

instructions.title: Install the command line tool
instructions.detail: On the machine that runs the Eve agent, install the tealbrick command line tool from the Tealbrick releases page.

instructions.title: Connect the agent
instructions.detail: Run this command and approve the request in the Portal page it shows (one click).

instructions.title: Use the bridge from Eve
instructions.detail: In the Eve agent, use the package @opt2-tealbrick/harness-eve (connectEveToBridge). It starts the local relay and turns the granted apps into Eve tools.

harnesses.label: Agent on the tealbrick command line

instructions.title: Install the command line tool
instructions.detail: On the agent's machine, install the tealbrick command line tool from the Tealbrick releases page.

instructions.title: Connect the agent
instructions.detail: Run this command and approve the request in the Portal page it shows (one click).

instructions.title: Run the agent
instructions.detail: Start the agent with an agent-serve file. Its harness is either claude (Claude Agent SDK via @opt2-tealbrick/harness-claude) or command (your own program).

instructions.title: Connect the agent machine
instructions.detail: On the agent's machine, install the tealbrick command line tool and run this command. Approve the request in the Portal page it shows.

instructions.title: Local MCP (stdio)
instructions.detail: Configure your agent with this MCP server command. It runs a local relay that signs in as this agent; all checks run in your workspace bridge.

instructions.title: Claude Code
instructions.detail: For Claude Code, add the server with this command.

copy.value: claude mcp add --scope user tealbrick -- tealbrick bridge serve --stdio --agent {{agentId}}

instructions.detail: Harnesses that support remote MCP with OAuth can use this URL instead and approve in Portal.
